datasets.help: Per data row its columns, each column of a row described individually under keys.

valueRef.label: V
valueRef.title: The value column of the row (slot V), numeric and required
valueRef.help: The value column of the row (slot V), numeric and required. Without it the row is kept but not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

groupRef.label: G
groupRef.title: The group column of the row (slot G), optional
groupRef.help: The group column of the row (slot G), optional; it splits the row into series, one per group value. Empty until one is chosen.

binMode.help: How the bins (the bars) are formed: automatically or with a fixed width. Automatic: width = range of all visible values divided by ⌈log₂ n⌉ + 1 bins (at least 3, Sturges), rounded to a round value; n counts the values of all visible series. Fixed: the set bin width applies; if it is empty, the width is determined automatically.

binWidth.help: The fixed width of each bin, a number greater than 0 in the units of the values. Empty means automatic width. The option can only be chosen with a fixed width.

confLevel.help: The confidence level in percent, greater than 0 and less than 100 (for example 95). It determines the confidence intervals in the statistics table.

showStats.help: Show or hide the statistics per series below the chart.

stats.help: Per plotted series its statistics and confidence intervals, structured like modules.shared.types.SeriesStats; empty while nothing can be computed.

series.help: The series built from the data rows with their presentation (name, values, colors, normal curve), or an object with “error” and “params” when no series can be built.

shown.help: The series after the chart editor settings. Empty as long as there are no series; series hidden in the editor are included but not visible.

setBinMode.help: Chooses how the bins are formed: automatic or with a fixed width. With automatic, a set bin width is reset.

params.binMode: 'auto' or 'manual'. Any other value is an error.
params.command: The command as one object with binMode.
